method: 5 perspective-diverse independent reviewers (re-derivation, recipe-attack, metric-interpretation, leak-validity, steelman-opposite) re-scored all 8041 candidates from the shipped checkpoint on CPU, re-derived every committed number bit-for-bit, characterized TRM's real wrong-candidate distribution vs the trained corruption families, and swept eval-side steelman constructions + 1 synthesis. Workflow gap3-stage2-adversarial-verify (run wf_058c7320-997).

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: Full CPU re-derivation from the checkpoint + pool reproduces EVERY committed number bit-for-bit (all 9 rankers' pass@1/2, oracle 19/31=0.6129, AUROC 0.5442/0.5228/0.6181 vs vote 0.9235, all shortcut correlations, bootstrap CIs [-0.4516,-0.129] and [0,0], headroom -1.7998, n_params 1107489); the only deltas are rounding (0.59027->0.5903) and a 3e-4 CPU/GPU float drift in pearson_E_gridsize. Split hygiene independently verified: 0 pool-task overlap with the 504+56 train/val names, 0/105 pool demo grid-pairs found in the training corpus by content hash, the 376/400 training2-leak audit figure exact, 29/30 pool tasks confirmed inside training2 (exclusion was necessary). The exact [0.0,0.0] union CI is genuine, not a bug: E receives a nonzero LOTO-logistic weight (+0.16 std-ized) but the union+E top-2 set is identical to union in 31/31 tasks. Rescue probes all fail: scoring with ALL demos (committed eval truncates to 4; 6 entries affected) gives identical 0.0645/0.1613; reversed-energy is worse (pass@2 0.129, AUROC 0.4558) so no sign bug; vote tie-breaking is at its PESSIMAL value (0.4516 of [0.4516,0.4839]) so the EBM deficit is understated; energies are non-degenerate (median within-task std 0.80). Two minor honest flaws: (1) the in-script "no-oracle structural audit" asserts (arc3_gap3_stage2_transition_ebm.py:481-483) are tautologies (`assert X or True` — dead code; the property itself holds, verified independently: 12/31 entries contain no correct candidate, no gold grids in file); (2) best_val_top1=0.5903 is a max-over-17-noisy-evals — mean of last 10 evals is 0.5333 and an independent full-val re-measurement with fresh negatives (seed 999, n=269) gives 0.5204+/-0.0597, so the val headline carries ~6-7pt best-checkpoint selection optimism, though 0.52 is still ~5.7x chance and the transfer-failure contrast (val >>chance vs eval AUROC ~chance) stands.
reviewer_verdicts.lens: RE-DERIVATION: loaded results/arc3_gap3_stage2_ebm.pt on CPU, re-implemented the model verbatim, re-scored all 8041 candidates from results/arc3_gap3_stage2_eval_pool.json.gz, and independently recomputed every committed metric (rankers, AUROC suite, shortcuts, LCG bootstrap, grouped-LOTO union, gates), plus leak/no-oracle/tie-sensitivity/sign-flip/demo-truncation/val-authenticity probes (/tmp/stage2_rederive.py, /tmp/stage2_hostile_probes.py).
reviewer_verdicts.next_step: For Stage 2 v2: (a) close the negative-distribution gap without forfeiting generator-independence by training on REAL wrong candidates harvested from a generator run on TRAINING-split tasks only (e.g., a different TRM seed/checkpoint's dump on arc-agi_training), since the hard-negative AUROC 0.6181 shows weak real content signal the synthetic-corruption recipe fails to sharpen; (b) report mean-val (or a held-out re-measured val) alongside best-val to remove the ~6-7pt best-checkpoint selection optimism in a2_overfit_audit; (c) replace the tautological asserts at arc3_gap3_stage2_transition_ebm.py:481-483 with a real structural check (key-whitelist over entries/candidates); (d) any positive at this scale must re-confirm at the 400-task pool per the artifact's own n=31 caveat.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: Conductor GPU rule respected: all probes ran with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" on CPU (full 8041-candidate re-score: 4s). Checkpoint train log internally consistent: best 0.5903 at step 1750, then exactly 10 non-improving evals (2000..4250) triggering patience-10 early stop. AUROC macro computed over 18 (not 19) oracle tasks because one oracle entry has a single candidate (gold only, no negatives) — matches the suite's None-skip logic, not an error. Gold's median E-rank in oracle tasks is 6 (worst cases 747/754, 36/599), confirming near-uninformative energy on real candidates. Pool cross-checked against the Stage-1 sidecar: (votes,correct) multisets match 31/31. Pool tasks are 30/30 in ARC-1 evaluation split, 0/30 in evaluation2.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: Negative-distribution coverage gap quantified: only 72/1890 = 3.8% of TRM's real wrong candidates (19 oracle-hit tasks) are exact members of the 8 trained corruption families (28.2% by vote mass), while the decisive classes are structured near-misses (29.7%, median Hamming 0.10, 208/562 with <=5% cells wrong) and plausible-but-wrong rule applications (59.1%, same shape, >30% cells differ) — neither represented in training (cell-noise is uniform-random). The EBM aces exactly its curriculum on the REAL pool — the lone identity-copy candidate ranked at E-percentile 1.00 (dead last), gold-vs-demo-copy AUROC 0.833, size-pattern violators pushed to E-pct 0.764 — but is at/below chance on the untrained 96%: gold-vs-near-miss(<=5%) AUROC 0.481, gold-vs-same-shape-far 0.469, spearman(E, Hamming-to-gold)=0.04. This works-as-trained/fails-where-untrained signature is the cleanest possible recipe-failure fingerprint; the concept survives because the pool is separable (vote AUROC 0.9235) and headroom exists (oracle 0.6129 > vote 0.4516). Bonus sharpening: EBM pass@2 0.1613 is statistically indistinguishable from a RANDOM ranker's expected 0.1432 on this pool — 'weak but vote-orthogonal' should read 'approximately random at selection'.
reviewer_verdicts.lens: RECIPE-ATTACK: characterize TRM's real wrong-candidate distribution vs the 8 synthetic corruption families; test whether the EBM solves its trained families on the real pool; audit the train log for undertraining; decide recipe-vs-concept.
reviewer_verdicts.next_step: Stage-2 v2 with a real-error-shaped negative curriculum: (1) mine hard negatives from an INDEPENDENT generator's actual wrong candidates on the 560 TRAINING tasks (a weaker/earlier non-TRM model or early TRM checkpoint preserves generator-independence w.r.t. the eval generator); (2) replace uniform cell-noise with STRUCTURED near-miss synthesis (single-object recolor/move/delete, off-by-one object placement, wrong-color-of-correct-shape) targeting the <=5%-cell class; (3) fix the resolution bottleneck — drop global mean pooling (e.g., keep a spatial feature map + cellwise-diff features) so 1-2-cell differences are resolvable, since the current encoder is at chance (0.481) there even in principle; (4) gate before any pool re-eval: gold-vs-structured-near-miss(<=5%) AUROC > 0.65 on held-out TRAINING tasks, and at eval require EBM pass@2 > random-ranker expectation (0.1432), not just > 0; retire the trained-content-energy lineage on this pool if structured-negative v2 still lands at random.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: Independent CPU re-score of all 8041 candidates from results/arc3_gap3_stage2_ebm.pt reproduced every committed number exactly (VOTE 0.4194/0.4516, EBM 0.0645/0.1613, oracle 0.6129, macro AUROC 0.5442 over n=18 scoreable tasks, hard-neg 0.6181, UNION noE/+E both 0.4839). Probe scripts: /tmp/stage2_hostile_probe.py, /tmp/stage2_residual_checks.py; committed artifact results/arc3_gap3_stage2_transition_ebm.json; source scripts/experiments/arc3_gap3_stage2_transition_ebm.py. Integrity checks passed: the one tied-top-vote task (5833af48) has no correct candidate among the 6 tied, so vote pass@2 is not export-order luck; gold labels used for scoring only; split-leak assertion present at train time; the single ragged/empty candidate grid in the pool is handled by clip_grid (no crash, no bias). Undertraining ruled out for THIS recipe: val_top1 peaked 0.5903 at step 1750 then 10 flat evals -> early stop at 4250 (saturated), though in-distribution val of only 0.59 vs 10 negatives shows the recipe also caps in-distribution mastery (architecture resolution + 560-task corpus). Minor reporting gaps in the artifact (none verdict-changing): (1) the 'E is vote-orthogonal, just weak' framing omits that EBM selection is ~= the 0.1432 random-ranker baseline; (2) 3 of the EBM's 5 pass@2 hits are tiny pools (n_cands 4-5) where random pass@2 is 0.4-0.5 — only f0df5ff0 (gold E-rank 1/212) is a genuine selection success; (3) demos truncated to MAX_DEMOS=4 for 6/31 entries (5,5,5,6,6,6 demos) — minor context loss; (4) gold mean within-task E-percentile is 0.43, i.e., the energy barely prefers gold to the median candidate. Per-task gold E-ranks include catastrophic cases (c3202e5a: 747/754, below chance) confirming no rule-consistency signal on plausible-but-wrong candidates. Recommend the artifact's interpretation be amended from 'does not transfer' to 'trained on a negative distribution with ~4% exact overlap (28% by vote mass) with real generator errors; at/below chance on the disjoint 96%'.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The negative is STRONGER than committed: EBM_ENERGY pass@2=0.1613 (5/31) is statistically indistinguishable from a RANDOM ranker — exact Poisson-binomial null over this pool's task sizes gives E[hits]=4.44, P(X>=5)=0.468 (vote's 14 hits: p=8.9e-9). Four of E's five top-2 hits are trivially small pools (n=1,4,5,5); the only genuine one is f0df5ff0 (gold ranked 1/212, above 1-cell perturbations — proof the architecture CAN do fine rule discrimination). Zero complementary hits (E never top-2s a task vote misses), and no E-using ranker beats vote: vote-topM-then-E rerank DEGRADES monotonically with M (0.4516 at M=2 -> 0.2903 at M=5 -> 0.1613 at M=20), so E demotes gold inside plausible shortlists more often than it rescues it. Meanwhile the macro(0.5442)-vs-hard(0.6181) AUROC 'inversion' is quantization noise, not 'E understands plausible candidates': on the same 17 tasks easy-neg AUROC=0.5016 vs hard=0.618 but paired sign test is 8-vs-7 (p~1.0), the hard number rests on only 90 gold-neg pairs with per-task values quantized to {0,0.5,1} (median 1-3 hard negs/task), and pair-weighted hard=0.5667 vs easy=0.5206. Stage 1's opposite-direction inversion was the same artifact in mirror.
reviewer_verdicts.next_step: Stage 3 recipe fix, not concept abandonment: (1) train negatives must match the REAL error distribution — identity-copy (a trained family) occurs 1/8022 times in TRM's deduped pool, and 91.5% of real negatives share gold's shape (E is weakest exactly there: same-shape macro AUROC 0.5843, pair-weighted ~0.52, vs 0.6726 on diff-shape) — so mine TRM wrong candidates from TRAINING-split tasks (keeps eval-task hygiene, drops strict generator-independence) or make same-shape near-miss corruptions dominate the mix; (2) fix the encoder (6/31 eval entries silently truncate demos to MAX_DEMOS=4; global mean-pooled CNN reduces to palette statistics — on c3202e5a E ranks gold 747/754 while gold differs from the vote-leader by ONE cell); (3) gate Stage 3 on pair-weighted AUROC vs same-shape real negatives > 0.70 BEFORE any rerank attempt (vote needs ~0.92 to be competitive); (4) cosmetic: replace the vacuous no-oracle asserts (lines 481-483, `assert X or True` checks nothing) with real ones, and gloss the union CI [0,0] as '0/31 top-2 sets changed', not a confidence statement.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: REPRODUCTION: loaded results/arc3_gap3_stage2_ebm.pt on CPU, rescored all 8041 candidates in 3.2s; every committed number reproduced exactly (pass@K for all 9 rankers spot-checked, AUROC suite, oracle 19/31, shortcut diagnostics, union, bootstrap LCG CI). (a) AUROC inversion: explained above — noise from tiny hard-neg counts; additionally hard negs are NOT identity copies (0/349), refuting the 'E rejects trained-family lookalikes' mechanism; the real mechanism is shape: E partially understands wrong-SHAPE negatives (0.673) and is near-chance on same-shape near-misses (pair-weighted ~0.52), which are 91.5% of TRM's real errors — the precise transfer gap. (b) MRR vote=0.7645 vs E=0.2870; median gold rank 1 vs 6; mean 5.2 vs 48.5 (E's tail: c3202e5a gold at 747/754). (c) The 5 vote-recoverable headroom tasks: E gold ranks 36/599 (vote 65), 3/8 (vote 7), 747/754 (vote 3), 5/19 (vote 3), 6/32 (vote 5) — better than vote on 2, catastrophically worse on the single most recoverable task (c3202e5a, gold 1 vote behind leader; E prefers junk with entirely different palettes; E(gold)=1.454 > E(leader)=1.431). E converts 0/5; headroom capture truly 0. Head-to-head E(gold)<E(top-voted-wrong) in 12/18 (n.s., p~0.24) — a faint correct pairwise preference that global ranking drowns under hundreds of low-E junk candidates. (d) Union CI [0.0,0.0] is degenerate-but-correct: refit grouped-LOTO unions are decision-identical — 31/31 top-2 candidate SETS unchanged by adding E, so per-task pass@1 AND pass@2 indicator vectors are identical and every bootstrap delta is exactly 0. The logistic does give E a consistent right-signed weight (mean +0.163 vs -0.763 for log1p-votes, 21% relative) — weak vote-orthogonal signal present, never decision-relevant. (e) Zero E-only tasks. HOSTILE CHECKS PASSED: no-oracle verified independently (pool keys: task/demos/test_input/candidates{votes,q_mean,correct,grid}; no gold output grids); split hygiene verified from checkpoint (pool tasks ∩ 560 train+val names = empty); f3e62deb duplicate correctly grouped in LOTO; vote baseline tie-handling is CONSERVATIVE (insertion-order gives 0.4516; best-case tie order 0.4839, only c3202e5a fragile) so the E<vote gap is robust to tie order. FLAWS FOUND (all minor, none verdict-threatening): (1) in-code no-oracle asserts are no-ops (`or True`); (2) hard-neg AUROC 0.6181 reported without n_pairs=90 context and is statistically unsupported as an inversion; (3) union CI presentation implies a measured interval where the data is decision-invariant; (4) MAX_DEMOS=4 truncation on 6/31 entries undisclosed in artifact. RECIPE-vs-CONCEPT: RECIPE — model learns the synthetic objective (val 0.59 vs 0.09 chance), shows real discrimination capacity (f0df5ff0), but was trained against a negative distribution provably disjoint from TRM's real errors; the concept retains an honest path (real-error negatives from training split, near-miss-dominated corruptions, richer demo encoding). The sober counterweight: the gap to competitiveness is enormous (0.52 pair-weighted vs vote's 0.92), so the concept is unproven, merely not refuted.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The EBM's pass@2 0.1613 is barely above the RANDOM-ranker expectation of 0.1432 (many entries have few candidates: min 1, median 56), and gold's median within-task rank fraction under E is exactly 0.50 — chance. Yet the SAME checkpoint pushed through the SAME eval scoring path on held-out val tasks with fresh-seed synthetic negatives scores top-1 0.5167 / AUROC 0.8520. Together these prove the negative is real (no eval-path bug; the energy simply carries ~zero ranking signal on TRM's real wrong candidates) and pin the cause to synthetic-corruption-to-real-error distribution shift. The committed artifact, if anything, OVERSTATES the EBM by not reporting the random baseline.
reviewer_verdicts.next_step: (1) Patch the vacuous no-oracle asserts at scripts/experiments/arc3_gap3_stage2_transition_ebm.py:481-483 (`assert X or True` is always-true; replace with real key-structure checks) and add the random-ranker pass@2 baseline (0.1432) to the artifact. (2) Highest-information Stage-2b within generator-independence: train with hard negatives mined from a generator's wrong candidates on TRAINING tasks only (e.g., TRM scored on its own training split), keeping the eval generator unseen — this tests real-error transfer without leaking the eval distribution; pair with attention-over-demos rule encoding instead of mean-pooling. (3) Per the artifact's own caveat, any follow-up must re-confirm at 400-task scale with grouped folds before claims.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: All committed claims verified by re-execution: (a) split 504/56 deterministic from seed 12345, pool tasks in neither split, corpus = exactly training+concept (hash b830e5a8d8e5a089 matches), training2 exclusion real, overlap audit reproduced exactly (eval1-in-train2 376/400; pool-in-train2 29/30; pool-in-corpus 0; no content-level leak — shared grids are trivial 1x1/3x3 generics). (b) Pool has no gold grids (12 oracle-miss entries contain gold nowhere); votes/q_mean/correct byte-identical row-aligned with Stage-1 npz (8041 rows). (c) Union LOTO groups f3e62deb's two entries together (verified in code); global-OLS residual control is fit on the full pool but uses no gold labels and lost anyway. (d) Edge cases nil: 0 oversized/ragged/clip-changed grids, 1/8041 empty grid (incorrect), demo truncation (6/31 entries with >4 demos) changes nothing — pass@2 identical at 0.1613 with all demos. (e) CPU reproduction matches every headline number and the verdict string byte-for-byte; sole delta is pearson_E_gridsize -0.0899 vs -0.0896 (CUDA/CPU float jitter on the weakest diagnostic). Vote baseline 0.4516 is the tie-WORST-case (best-case 0.4839), so the EBM deficit is conservative. Blemishes found, none verdict-changing: vacuous `assert X or True` audit asserts (decorative confidence — the property holds but the mechanical check is fake), and the missing random-ranker baseline in the artifact. RECIPE not CONCEPT: the model demonstrably learns a content energy (0.852 AUROC on synthetic negatives via the eval path; 0.6181 on real hard negatives votes>=5, weakly above chance) — the failure is the 8-family synthetic-corruption negative distribution, not the trained-content-energy idea; richer negatives/encoders within generator-independence remain untested. Caveat stands: n=31, oracle ceiling 0.6129, vote AUROC 0.9235 is a high bar.

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: Complementarity is structurally IMPOSSIBLE on this pool, not just unrealized: E's pass@2 hit-set {1,8,9,19,28} (E_tta8 adds 17) is a STRICT SUBSET of vote's 14 hits, and each of the 5 vote-missed oracle entries (2,16,22,29,30) has >=2 wrong candidates that Pareto-dominate gold in (votes,E) for 4/5 entries — so NO monotone combination of vote+E can exceed 15/31=0.4839, the value the no-E union already reaches. In the single decisive vote-tie (entry 22, c3202e5a, gold tied at 15 votes), E and E_tta8 break the tie WRONG while TRM's own q_mean breaks it right (vote+qmean=0.4839): the trained energy underperforms even a free tie-breaker. The best honest E construction found anywhere — dihedral-8 TTA-averaged energy, eval-side only — reaches pass@2 0.1935 (macro AUROC 0.5852 vs committed 0.5442), with bootstrap CI95 vs vote [-0.4194,-0.1290] (grouped-by-task [-0.4194,-0.1212]) still entirely below zero. Every other steelman failed: all vote-topK-rerank-by-E shortlists <= vote (monotonically worse with K); slot1=vote/slot2=argminE = 0.4194 < vote; every E-bearing LOTO logistic <= 0.4839 with z-scored E actively degrading the union to 0.4516; probe+E ensembles HURT (0.3548/0.3226 < probe-alone 0.4194); per-entry AUROC anticorrelates with grid size (-0.44) and the entries where E is perfect (AUROC 1.0) are ones vote already hits, so gating can only recover vote. Bonus conservativeness finding: file-order vote tie-breaking puts the committed baseline 0.4516 at the UNFAVORABLE end of the tie-shuffle distribution (mean 0.4698, max 0.4839), so the committed E-vs-vote gap is if anything understated — and the Stage-1 union's +0.0323 'value-add' over vote is exactly one q_mean tie-break entry.
reviewer_verdicts.next_step: The val 0.5903 (synthetic) -> 0.5442 AUROC (real) gap localizes the failure to the synthetic-corruption negative distribution plus a weak relation architecture (global-avg-pool CNN + mean demo pooling), not to the trained-content-energy concept — oracle headroom (5 entries, 16pp of pass@2) remains untouched by every signal. Next: (1) harvest REAL TRM wrong candidates from the TRAINING-split dump as negatives (forfeits strict generator-independence but keeps task-split hygiene; zero eval leak), (2) upgrade the encoder (per-cell cross-attention between rule and candidate instead of mean-pooled 256-d embeddings), (3) keep dihedral-8 TTA at eval (free +0.03 pass@2 / +0.04 AUROC, demonstrated here), and (4) gate any future selection eval on hard-negative (votes>=5) AUROC > 0.75 measured first — at 0.6181 today the selection eval was predictably doomed; do not spend another selection run below that bar. Re-confirm at 400-task scale per the artifact's own caveat.
reviewer_verdicts.notes: Independent CPU re-scoring of all 8041 candidates from the shipped checkpoint (results/arc3_gap3_stage2_ebm.pt) against the shipped pool reproduced EVERY committed number bit-for-bit: vote pass@2 0.4516, EBM 0.0645/0.1613, q_mean 0.2903, oracle 0.6129, macro/pairweighted/hard AUROC 0.5442/0.5228/0.6181, pearson(E,votes) -0.0113, and an independent bootstrap (numpy, B=2000) gave E-vote CI95 [-0.4516,-0.1290] matching the committed LCG CI exactly. Stage-1 npz is row-aligned with the pool (votes/q_mean/correct/task_idx all identical), validating the probe-ensemble probes. Split hygiene verified from the checkpoint itself: 504 train + 56 val task names, zero overlap with the 30 pool task names; pool contains no gold output grids. Audit scripts at /tmp/stage2_audit/{score_pool,reproduce,tta,steelman,steelman2,steelman3,steelman4}.py; TTA scores at /tmp/stage2_audit/tta_scores.npz. RECIPE not CONCEPT: this v1 energy is refuted as a selector on this pool, but its in-distribution ceiling was already mediocre (0.59 top-1 vs 11 easy synthetic negatives) and the failure is traceable to synthetic->real negative shift, so a real-error-trained / richer-architecture v2 retains a live path. One concept-level warning for the v2 designer: vote macro AUROC 0.9235 means any content energy must beat what is effectively a 1000-sample TRM self-ensemble — the bar is high, and hard-neg AUROC 0.6181 vs 0.9235 is the honest distance-to-go metric.

synthesis.recommended_next_step: Run exactly ONE Stage-2 v2 with the recipe fixed along the three axes the panel converged on, behind hard go/no-go gates — then close GAP-3 with an honest bound if it fails. (1) NEGATIVES: mine REAL wrong candidates from a generator run on TRAINING-split tasks only (a different TRM seed/early checkpoint or a weaker non-TRM model — preserves eval-generator independence and task hygiene with zero eval leak), and replace uniform cell-noise with STRUCTURED near-miss synthesis (single-object recolor/move/delete, off-by-one placement, wrong-color-of-correct-shape) so same-shape <=5%-cell errors dominate the mix, matching the real error distribution (29.7% near-miss + 59.1% plausible-but-wrong, 91.5% same-shape). (2) ARCHITECTURE: remove the resolution bottleneck — drop global mean pooling for a spatial feature map with cellwise-diff features or per-cell cross-attention between rule and candidate (currently at chance, 0.481, on 1-2-cell differences even in principle: c3202e5a gold differs from the leader by ONE cell and ranks 747/754). Keep dihedral-8 TTA at eval (demonstrated free +0.03 pass@2 / +0.04 AUROC). (3) GATES BEFORE ANY SELECTION EVAL: pair-weighted gold-vs-same-shape-near-miss AUROC > 0.70 on held-out TRAINING tasks (at today's 0.6181 hard-neg vs vote's 0.9235 the selection run was predictably doomed), and at eval require pass@2 > the 0.1432 random baseline, not just > 0; report mean-val not best-val. If structured-negative v2 still lands at random, RETIRE the trained-content-energy lineage on this pool and close GAP-3 with the honest bound: the 16pp oracle headroom (0.6129 vs 0.4516) is real but unreachable by scalar (Stage 0), latent (Stage 1), or trained content-energy (Stage 2) selectors — the remaining serious candidates are execution/program-synthesis verification or hybrid approaches, not cheaper energies. Any positive must re-confirm at the 400-task pool with grouped folds per the artifact's own n=31 caveat. Per the Missing-Verifier Gap Logging rule, also append the quantified gap to ops/verifier_gaps.md: missing discriminator = same-shape near-miss rule-consistency (the 91.5% class where E is at 0.52 and vote is at 0.92).

synthesis.summary: GAP-3 Stage-2 NEGATIVE ADVERSARIALLY CONFIRMED — 5/5 CONFIRMS_NEGATIVE, key_numbers_match 5/5, worst severity minor, unanimous RECIPE (not concept) attribution. REPRODUCTION: every reviewer independently re-scored all 8041 candidates / 31 tasks from the shipped checkpoint (results/arc3_gap3_stage2_ebm.pt) + pool (results/arc3_gap3_stage2_eval_pool.json.gz) on CPU (~3-4s) and reproduced EVERY committed number bit-for-bit: vote 0.4194/0.4516, EBM 0.0645/0.1613, q_mean 0.2903, oracle 19/31=0.6129, AUROC macro/pair-weighted/hard 0.5442/0.5228/0.6181 vs vote 0.9235, union no-E/+E both 0.4839, bootstrap CIs [-0.4516,-0.129] and [0,0], headroom -1.7998, n_params 1107489; sole deltas are rounding (0.59027→0.5903) and 3e-4 CPU/GPU float jitter on pearson_E_gridsize. VALIDITY: split hygiene held under three independent attacks (0 pool-task overlap with 504+56 train/val names; 0/105 pool demo grid-pairs in the training corpus by content hash; training2-leak audit 376/400 and 29/30 exact; no gold grids anywhere in the pool — 12/31 entries contain no correct candidate at all); the union+E CI [0,0] is genuine decision-invariance (31/31 top-2 sets identical despite E receiving a right-signed +0.16 LOTO-logistic weight), not a bug; vote tie-breaking sits at its PESSIMAL value (0.4516 of tie-range [0.4516,0.4839]) so the committed E deficit is conservative; sign-flip (reversed E is worse: 0.129, AUROC 0.4558), all-demos rescue (identical 0.0645/0.1613), and tie-shuffle probes all failed to rescue. THE NEGATIVE IS STRONGER THAN COMMITTED: EBM pass@2=0.1613 (5/31) is statistically indistinguishable from a RANDOM ranker — exact Poisson-binomial null gives E[hits]=4.44, P(X>=5)=0.468 (vote's 14 hits: p=8.9e-9); 4 of E's 5 hits are tiny pools (n_cands 1-5; only f0df5ff0, gold 1/212, is a genuine selection); E's hit-set is a STRICT SUBSET of vote's (zero complementary hits); complementarity is structurally impossible — on 4/5 vote-missed oracle entries >=2 wrong candidates Pareto-dominate gold in (votes,E), so NO monotone vote+E combination can exceed 0.4839, which the no-E union (vote+q_mean tie-break) already reaches; vote-topM-rerank-by-E degrades monotonically (0.4516@M=2 → 0.1613@M=20); the best honest steelman found across ~all panel constructions (dihedral-8 TTA-averaged energy) reaches only pass@2 0.1935 / AUROC 0.5852, CI95 vs vote [-0.4194,-0.1290] entirely below zero; and on the single decisive vote tie (c3202e5a, gold one vote behind the leader) E breaks the tie WRONG while TRM's free q_mean breaks it right. RECIPE DIAGNOSIS (the decisive evidence): only 72/1890 = 3.8% of TRM's real wrong candidates (28.2% by vote mass) are members of the 8 trained synthetic-corruption families; the EBM aces exactly its curriculum on the real pool (the lone identity-copy ranked dead last at E-percentile 1.00; gold-vs-demo-copy AUROC 0.833; size-pattern violators pushed to 0.764) but is at/below chance on the untrained 96% — gold-vs-near-miss(<=5% cells) AUROC 0.481, gold-vs-same-shape-far 0.469, spearman(E, Hamming-to-gold)=0.04 — while 91.5% of real negatives share gold's shape, precisely where E is weakest (pair-weighted ~0.52 vs 0.6726 on wrong-shape). The same checkpoint through the same eval path scores 0.5167 top-1 / 0.852 AUROC on fresh synthetic val negatives, proving no eval-path bug and pinning the cause to synthetic-to-real negative distribution shift. Capacity exists (f0df5ff0 gold beat 211 one-cell perturbations) but the global-mean-pooled CNN cannot resolve 1-2-cell differences (c3202e5a: gold differs from the vote leader by ONE cell yet ranks 747/754). Honest counterweight: the concept is unproven, merely unrefuted — distance-to-competitiveness is pair-weighted ~0.52 vs vote's 0.92, an enormous gap. Minor flaws found, none verdict-changing: tautological no-oracle asserts (script lines 481-483, `assert X or True` is dead code — the property itself was verified independently); best_val_top1=0.5903 carries ~6-7pt best-checkpoint selection optimism (mean-of-last-10 0.5333; fresh-negative re-measure 0.5204±0.0597, still ~5.7x chance); missing random-ranker baseline (0.1432) in the artifact; undisclosed MAX_DEMOS=4 truncation on 6/31 entries (verified metric-invariant); hard-neg AUROC 0.6181 rests on only 90 pairs and the macro-vs-hard "inversion" is quantization noise (paired sign test 8-vs-7, p~1.0). GAP-3 LEDGER AFTER THREE STAGES: Stage 0 (q_halt scalar) = vote shadow; Stage 1 (latent z_mean) = vote shadow with a structural vote leak; Stage 2 (trained generator-independent content energy) = approximately random on real TRM candidates. The oracle headroom (0.6129 vs 0.4516 = 5 present-but-mis-voted entries, 16pp of pass@2) is real, replicated across all three stages, and untouched by every signal tested so far.

title: Adversarial-verify round over GAP-3 Stage-2 transition-EBM negative (GAP-3 design Section 4)
